_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. To get the IDs: enable Discord's
Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode, then right-click the message >
Copy Message Link. The link is .../channels/<guild_id>/<channel_id>/<message_id>.
emojis: [] means auto-discover and track every reaction on the message.
Restrict it with e.g. ["\u2705"] or [":atomone:"] for custom emoji.
